svg.title: Тяга в хаммере сверху — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated Hammer Strength style plate-loaded HIGH ROW machine, side-front view, athlete facing and leaning against an upright chest pad, both feet down. Tall overhead pivot assembly with two individual rigid lever arms and visible round weight plates loaded on side pegs. Both hands grasp high handles on the rigid arms, never cables. Start left: arms reach diagonally forward and upward above shoulder level. Finish right: elbows drive down and back beside ribs, handles pulled to sides of upper torso. Same chest pad, seat and machine in both phases; clearly show rigid levers connecting handles to upper pivots and visible plate-loaded pegs. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
